Air Cricket

Face pace and spin under the lights. Aim with the arrows; the length decides front foot or back, and timing decides how sweetly you middle it. Watch the field map and find the gaps.

↑Straight: drive, or punch off the back foot
↑←→Press together to drive through cover or mid-on
←→Square: cut, pull, square drive or flick
↓←→Press together to play fine: glance or late cut
↓Block
ShiftHold to hit it in the air: lofts, hooks, upper cuts
QERSweep, reverse sweep, scoop
ADStep across before the ball arrives · M field map

Controls

Swipe left or right fast to play to that side, angle the swipe upward to hit it in the air. Swipe down for a straight drive. Push toward the camera to block. Lifting your hand is your backlift and is ignored. Drift sideways slowly to step across the crease. Press C to recentre. Keys still work as a backup.
